4.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has also submitted that the opposite party no.2 is enjoying her matrimonial life with applicant no.1, therefore, the entire proceeding against the applicants may be quashed.
5. Learned AGA also concedes the fact that the genesis of the prosecution is some matrimonial dispute and the said dispute has already been resolved between the parties.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, going through the contents of present application, F.I.R., statement of applicant no.1 as well as opposite party no.2 and other relevant materials, it is evident that the genesis of the prosecution is some matrimonial dispute,

The said dispute has already been resolved between the parties and presently, applicant no.1 and opposite party no.2 are residing together and enjoying their married life, therefore, the prosecution in question will be futile one.

7. In view of the above, the present application is allowed and the entire proceeding of Case No.94239 of 2023 (State Vs. Shubham @ Deepu and Ors.), arising out of Case Crime No.0066/2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of DP Act,
PS- Kaiserbagh, District- Lucknow pending before ACJM-I, Room No.27, Lucknow are hereby quashed.
8.
